extracted.intended_audience: scholars and practitioners working on reviewer assignment systems (journal editors, conference organizers, grant managers, and researchers in peer review/IR/recommender systems)
extracted.subtask_description: A systematic literature review of the Reviewer Assignment Problem (RAP), classifying automated reviewer-assignment approaches, summarizing techniques used since 1992, and presenting potential future research directions for researchers and practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate reviewer assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Appropriate reviewer assignment significantly impacts the quality of proposal evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper emphasizes that the assignment step is crucial because it sets the basis for downstream review quality; systems should therefore prioritize making assignments that improve overall evaluation quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment of submissions to relevant reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Accurate and fair reviews are contingent on their assignment to relevant reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer-assignment methods should match submissions to reviewers with relevant expertise or topical fit; relevance is presented as a central desideratum for fairness and accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy and fairness of reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Review accuracy and fairness depend on who is assigned to evaluate a submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluations of RAP approaches should consider how well assignments preserve or improve the accuracy (correctness/quality) and fairness (unbiased/equitable treatment) of resulting reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need for automated assignment approaches (scalability/feasibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Due to the obvious restrictions of manual assignment, journal editors, conference organizers, and grant managers demand automatic reviewer assignment approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A practical RAP solution should address the limitations of manual processes (e.g., scale, time, complexity) and provide automated procedures suitable for real-world editorial/grant workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive classification and coverage of RAP techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: The survey classifies and discusses RAP approaches into two broad categories and numerous subcategories based on their underlying techniques, aiming to provide a comprehensive overview of available research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When producing or evaluating research on RAP, authors should situate their work within the existing taxonomy of techniques, clarify underlying methodological category, and explain how their approach relates to prior work; survey work should aim for broad, systematic coverage across databases and decades.
